name: util-linux
description: Essential collection of Linux system utilities including mount, umount, fdisk, blkid, losetup, lsblk, and libuuid/libblkid libraries for block device and filesystem management.
build: meson setup util-linux-2.40.2/build util-linux-2.40.2 --prefix="$PREFIX" --libdir="$PREFIX/lib" --buildtype=release --wrap-mode=nodownload -D build-login=disabled -D build-su=disabled -D build-runuser=disabled
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
